SSPS.description: Surface Spring Support (SSPS). Converts selected element faces/nodes into nodal point springs or elastic links; which Boundary fields are used is driven by CONVERT_TO and BOUNDARY.TYPE, and the element filtering is driven by ELEMENT.TYPE.

CONVERT_TO.description: Convert selected surface to nodal spring type (case-insensitive). POINT_SPRING = generate nodal point springs; ELASTIC_LINK = generate elastic links.

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary group name to assign the generated springs/links to.

NODE_ELEMS.description: Selected node or element list used as the source of the surface spring. For ELEMENT.TYPE=SOLID_NODE the keys are node keys; otherwise they are element keys.

KEYS.description: Explicit list of node or element ids.

ELEMENT.description: Element selection type and geometry parameters.

TYPE.description: Element type to filter the selection by (case-insensitive). FRAME = frame elements; PLANAR = planar elements; SOLID_FACE = solid element face (uses FACE); SOLID_NODE = solid faces resolved from selected nodes (treated as SOLID_FACE internally).

FACE.description: [TYPE=SOLID_FACE] Face number of the solid element on which the surface spring is applied.

WIDTH.description: [TYPE=FRAME] Tributary width used for a frame element surface spring.

BOUNDARY.description: Spring/link boundary definition. Which fields are consumed depends on CONVERT_TO and TYPE.

TYPE.description: Spring behavior type (case-insensitive). LINEAR = linear; COMP = compression-only; TENS = tension-only; MULTI = multi-linear.

DIR.description: Nonlinear/elastic-link direction. Used when CONVERT_TO=ELASTIC_LINK, or when CONVERT_TO=POINT_SPRING with TYPE in (COMP, TENS). 0=Normal(+), 1=Normal(-), 2=UCS X(+), 3=UCS X(-), 4=UCS Y(+), 5=UCS Y(-), 6=UCS Z(+), 7=UCS Z(-).

STIFF.description: [CONVERT_TO=POINT_SPRING, TYPE in (LINEAR, MULTI)] Node local axis stiffness (Sx, Sy, Sz) of the point spring.

PHU.description: Multi-linear function parameter. Used only when TYPE=MULTI (POINT_SPRING) or for a multi-linear elastic link.

SUBGRADE.description: Modulus of subgrade reaction. Used for nonlinear point springs (TYPE in COMP, TENS, MULTI) and for elastic links (CONVERT_TO=ELASTIC_LINK).

bDAMP.description: [CONVERT_TO=POINT_SPRING, TYPE in (LINEAR, MULTI)] Use damping constant/area.

DAMP.description: [CONVERT_TO=POINT_SPRING, TYPE in (LINEAR, MULTI)] Damping constant/area (Cx, Cy, Cz), applied when bDAMP is true.
